name: Economic time-window and edge-threshold diagnostic v1
status: Written before this grid calculation, AFTER prior full-sample research. Not a historical preregistration or untouched out-of-sample test.
universe: Existing full-rule, exact two adjacent 25bp point states, actual YES/NO, in-play trailing 20 observations/2 prices, data-valid CME; same economic combination may use contemporaneously best listed/synthetic route.
persistence: 3 exact consecutive minutes of SAME economic combination, same ET day, with all gates and edge >=threshold; independently monitor each combination BEFORE selecting the best contemporaneous qualified combination. At most first confirmed entry per meeting per rule.
primary_cost: Current economic fee .05*C*p*(1-p), plus 1 cent per digital, $5 per CME spread, digital cash funding 5% annual to meeting+1 day. Historical executable Poly book and CME margin funding unknown.
stress_cost: 2 cents execution loss; evaluate the SAME selected entry, NO retiming or parameter reselection.
selection_features: Only entry-time prices, known instrument/rules metadata, calendar/time, trailing liveness. Outcomes and terminal corrections excluded from candidate selector.
common_universe: Meetings with at least one valid primary observation in days1..60 and hours10:00<=t<15:00. A rule that abstains because its window has no observed eligible quotes has zero policy cashflow, explicitly flagged no-observation; this is not evidence of no market opportunity.
walkforward_cut: For each test meeting, meeting date minus60 calendar days at10:00ET. Freeze rule before any possible entry window. Use only prior common-universe meetings whose LATEST possible near/far terminal availability proxy across candidate instruments is earlier than this cut.
label_availability_proxy: End of latest delivery month +7 calendar days at00:00ET, AND known digital resolution. Conservative proxy only, current FRED/rule vintage is not historic point-in-time evidence.
training_score: mean cash PnL cents per equivalent digital over ALL common mature meetings including abstentions minus ONE sample standard error; require score>0 and every leave-one-meeting-out mean>0. Max score, deterministic tie-break by rule id. Not a confidence interval or multiple-testing correction.
reporting: All27 cells including losses and abstentions; training vs sequential diagnostic; no-trade fallback; actual input and protocol hashes; sample size by meeting; cost stress at same entry; maximum t-statistic common-meeting sign-flip multiplicity stress, explicitly requiring symmetry and not a deployment test.
